name: diwa-design-system
description: Root workspace orchestration for Diwa Design System

scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:components && npm run publish:components:react && npm run publish:components:vue && npm run publish:components:angular
scripts.build:wrappers: npm run build:wrapper:react && npm run build:wrapper:vue && npm run build:wrapper:angular
scripts.build: npm run build:components && npm run build:wrappers
scripts.build:storefront:release: npm run build:components && npm run sync:stencil-assets && npm run build:storefront && npm run postprocess:storefront:out
scripts.deploy:storefront: npm run build:storefront:release && firebase deploy --only hosting:designDocs --project diwa-copilot-ai-491108
scripts.deploy:storefront:preview: npm run build:storefront:release && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --only designDocs --project diwa-copilot-ai-491108
